transcript.en: So, hello everyone. My name's Lou Miller and I'm going to be your tour guide today as we  take this fantastic boat trip around the Tasmanian coast.
transcript.zh: 哈喽，大家好。我是 Lou Miller，今天将由我来担任你们的导游，我们将在塔斯马尼亚海岸进行这次奇妙的游船之旅。

transcript.en: Before we set off, I just want to tell  you a few things about our journey.
transcript.zh: 在我们出发之前，我想告诉大家一些关于我们旅程的事宜。

transcript.en: Our boats aren't huge as you can see. We already have three staff members on board and  on top of that, we can transport a further fifteen people – that’s you – around the coastline.
transcript.zh: 如大家所见，我们的船并不大。我们已经有 3 名工作人员在船上，除此之外，我们还可以运送另外 15 个人——就是你们——绕海岸线行驶。

transcript.en: But please note if there are more than nine people on either side of the boat, we'll move  some of you over, otherwise all eighteen of us will end up in the sea!
transcript.zh: 但是请注意，如果船上有一边超过九个人，我们会把你们中的一些人移过来，否则我们十八个人都会落海！

transcript.en: We've recently upgraded all our boats.
transcript.zh: 我们最近升级了所有的船。

transcript.en: They used to be jet black, but our new ones now have  these comfortable dark red seats and a light-green exterior in order to stand out from others  and help promote our company.
transcript.zh: 它们曾经是黑色的，但现在的新船有舒适的深红色座椅和浅绿色的外观，以便从其他船中脱颖而出并帮助宣传我们的公司。

transcript.en: This gives our boats a rather unique appearance, don't you  think?
transcript.zh: 这个颜色给我们的船有一个相当独特的外观，你们不觉得吗？

transcript.en: We offer you a free lunchbox during the trip and we have three types.
transcript.zh: 我们在旅途中为大家提供免费午餐盒，我们有三种类型。

transcript.en: Lunchbox 1 contains  ham and tomato sandwiches. Lunchbox 2 contains a cheddar cheese roll and Lunchbox 3  is salad-based and also contains eggs and tuna.
transcript.zh: 午餐盒 1 包含火腿和番茄三明治。午餐盒 2 包含切达干酪卷，午餐盒 3 以沙拉为主，还包含鸡蛋和金枪鱼。

transcript.en: All three lunchboxes also have a packet of  crisps and chocolate bar inside. Please let staff know which lunchbox you prefer.
transcript.zh: 这三类午餐盒里面都还有一包薯片和巧克力棒。请联系工作人员你喜欢哪种午餐盒。

transcript.en: I'm sure I don't have to ask you not to throw anything into the sea.
transcript.zh: 我确定，我不用和大家强调咱们不要把任何东西扔进海里。

transcript.en: We don't have any bins to  put litter in, but Jess, myself or Ray, our other guide, will collect it from you after lunch and put  it all in a large plastic sack.
transcript.zh: 船上没有丢垃圾的垃圾箱，但 Jess、我自己或我们的另一位向导 Ray 会在午餐后从大家那里收集垃圾并将他们全部放入一个大塑料袋中。

transcript.en: The engine on the boat makes quite a lot of noise so before we head off, let me tell you a few  things about what you're going to see.
transcript.zh: 船上的发动机会发出很大的噪音，所以在我们出发之前，我要告诉你们一会我们会看到啥。

transcript.en: This area is famous for its ancient lighthouse, which you'll see from the boat as we turn past  the first little island.
transcript.zh: 该地区以其古老的灯塔而闻名，当我们转过第一个小岛时，你就会从船上看到。

transcript.en: It was built in 1838 to protect sailors as a number of shipwrecks had  led to significant loss of life.
transcript.zh: 它建于 1838 年，用来保护水手，因为许多沉船事故曾经导致了重大生命损失。

transcript.en: The construction itself was complicated as some of the original  drawings kept by the local council show. It sits right on top of the cliffs in a very isolated spot.
transcript.zh: 从地方委员会保存的一些原始图纸来看，这项建筑工程很复杂。它坐落在悬崖顶上一个非常偏僻的地方。

transcript.en: In the nineteenth century there were many jobs there, such as polishing the brass lamps, chopping firewood and cleaning windows, that kept lighthouse keepers busy.
transcript.zh: 在 19 世纪，那里曾有许多工作，例如抛光黄铜灯、砍柴和清洁窗户，让灯塔管理员忙得不可开交。

transcript.en: These workers  were mainly prison convicts until the middle of that century when ordinary families willing to  live in such circumstances took over.
transcript.zh: 这些工人主要是监狱犯，直到那个世纪中期，才被愿意生活在这里的普通家庭接管了。

transcript.en: Some of you have asked me what creatures we can expect to see.
transcript.zh: 你们中的一些人问我，我们可以看到什么生物。

transcript.en: I know everyone loves  the penguins, but they're very shy and, unfortunately, tend to hide from passing boats,
transcript.zh: 我知道每个人都喜欢企鹅，但它们非常害羞，不幸的是，它们往往会躲避过往的船只，

transcript.en: but  you might see birds in the distance, such as sea eagles, flying around the cliff edges where  they nest.
transcript.zh: 但你可能会看到远处的鸟类，如海雕，在它们筑巢的悬崖边缘飞来飞去。

transcript.en: When we get to the rocky area inhabited by fur seals, we'll stop and watch them  swimming around the coast.
transcript.zh: 当我们到达海狗栖息的岩石区域时，我们会停下来观看它们在海岸周围游泳。

transcript.en: They're inquisitive creatures so don't be surprised if one pops up  right in front of you.
transcript.zh: 他们是好奇的生物，所以如果他们突然出现在你面前，请不要感到惊讶。

transcript.en: Their predators, orca whales, hunt along the coastline too, but spotting  one of these is rare.
transcript.zh: 它们的捕食者逆戟鲸也沿着海岸线捕猎，但很少能见到。

transcript.en: Dolphins, on the other hand, can sometimes approach on their own or in groups as they ride the waves beside us.
transcript.zh: 另一方面，海豚有时会在冲浪时独自或成群接近我们。

transcript.en: Lastly, I want to mention the caves. Tasmania is famous for its caves and the ones we'll  pass by are so amazing that people are lost for words when they see them.
transcript.zh: 最后，我想提一下洞穴。塔斯马尼亚以其洞穴而闻名，我们将经过的洞穴是如此惊人，以至于看到它的人都无法用语言形容。

transcript.en: They can only  be approached by sea, but if you feel that you want to see more than we're able to show  you, then you can take a kayak into the area on another day and one of our staff will give  you more information on that.
transcript.zh: 他们只能通过海路接近，但如果你觉得自己想看的比我们所能展示的更多，那么你可以改天乘坐皮艇进入该地区，我们的工作人员将为你提供更多有关那里的信息。

transcript.en: What we'll do is to go through a narrow channel, past some  incredible rock formations and from there we'll be able to see the openings to the caves,
transcript.zh: 我们将要穿过一条狭窄的通道，经过一些令人难以置信的岩层，从那里我们将看到通往的洞穴的洞口，

transcript.en: and  at that point we'll talk to you about what lies beyond.
transcript.zh: 到时候我们再跟大家介绍那里还有什么。
